config.status: Forecast and analysis frozen before this analysis acquires or inspects the public 2025 event bytes; not prospective data collection, external preregistration, or global blinding
config.pooling: Use development events only. From highest fine bin downward, merge neighbors until both resources have at least 20 complete development events per class; merge any undersupported lowest remainder into its neighbor. Retain outer domain and actual log/linear widths.
config.resource_definition: Supplied GOES XRS-B start-to-peak or start-to-end integrated irradiance at the observer, J/m2, without additional background subtraction; not total radiated flare energy
config.eligibility: Finite positive peak irradiance, peak_saturated equal to zero, closed fixed coordinate domain, finite positive resource and positive corresponding event-window duration; preserve all exclusions and resource-specific missingness
config.cost_estimation: Arithmetic mean measured development fluence separately in each supported pooled class; no assumed power-law cost and no fit to evaluation outcomes
config.conditioning: Complete-case count shape conditional on the eligible evaluation event total; no absolute rate or total-fluence forecast
config.profile_definition: phi_j = (sum_j q / sum_all q) / (Delta log k_j / total Delta log k), retaining zero evaluation bins
config.margin_rationale: Exploratory operational margin fixed before acquisition: every resource density must be within [2/3,1.5] of the domain mean, distinguishing approximate equality from sustained 50% excess or 33% deficit. It is not derived from instrument accuracy, established prior law, or evaluation outcomes.
config.score_uncertainty: Independently resample 12 complete calendar-month vectors within each development year and within evaluation year; preserve joint bins and pair draws across forecasts and resource definitions
config.profile_candidate: Centered-bootstrap simultaneous log-profile band from orthopolity.profile_calibration.profile_decision; method benchmark and application gate must be retained before evaluation acquisition
config.application_gate: A formal profile verdict requires benchmark support for the matching small-block/heavy-tail/dependence regime and independently established applicability of the candidate's sampling assumptions. Calendar months are not declared independent/exchangeable by default. No resource bound is inferred from development or evaluation maxima. Failed or unestablished eligibility yields formal verdict unresolved regardless of conditional band or point estimate.
config.missingness_gate: Primary rise fluence must be complete among eligible in-domain peak events for an all-catalogue resource interpretation; otherwise retain complete-case forecasts but classify all-catalogue neutrality unresolved. End fluence is always an explicitly missingness-limited sensitivity.
config.zero_bin_policy: No evaluation-based pooling, dropping zero bins or smoothing. Unsupported bootstrap development costs invalidate that resource's score draw. Zero evaluation resource bins prevent a finite log band and produce an unresolved candidate result.
config.tls_policy: HTTPS certificate and hostname verification remain enabled. Prefer system OpenSSL CA bundle /etc/ssl/cert.pem when present, otherwise platform default roots; record TLS trust metadata without changing machine settings.
config.directory_information_before_freeze: NOAA directory listing names v1-0-1 annual 2025 product, about 611 KB, modified 2026-06-25; event bytes have not been acquired or inspected by this analysis
limitations: 2022-2024 development observations and the earlier study have already been inspected
Public 2025 catalogue is already measured, and local acquisition ordering does not establish global blindness
No catalogue completeness, exposure, overlapping-event or background correction
Related peak and fluence measurements share instrument and event definitions
One validation year supplies only 12 potentially seasonal/dependent monthly blocks
High-resource events may dominate monthly totals; finite sample maxima do not establish a physical upper bound
Within-class composition and solar-cycle changes may prevent cost transfer
Count-score intervals are conditional nominal bootstrap summaries, not a neutrality null test

config.description: Prospectively frozen repeated-sampling benchmark of complete-profile equivalence/departure/unresolved rules; separate development/evaluation streams, no tuning from evaluation.
config.resource: Generated additive per-block resource totals in arbitrary resource units; zero bins retained. Population estimand is normalized arithmetic mean raw resource per fixed log-bin width.

eligibility.rules: A family/block-count/method passes only if every frozen profile shape has false-equivalence and false-departure Wilson upper bounds <=0.065 and coverage Wilson lower bound >=0.925. Centered and known-bound methods use simultaneous full-vector coverage; the percentile extension uses Delta interval coverage and is not a simultaneous-vector method. Coverage/decision criteria are operational tolerances, not a theorem or universal certification. Missing reference methods are unavailable, not passing.
eligibility.application: Any eligibility is restricted to the simulated observation model. Twelve observed seasonal months, unknown fluence tails, independence and absent physical resource bounds cannot be certified by a favorable simulated family. Solar's robust primary verdict remains unresolved unless its sampling assumptions are independently justified.

config.stream_recipe: SeedSequence([stage_data_seed, block_count_index, profile_index, observation_family_index]); independent bootstrap stream SeedSequence([bootstrap_seed, stage_index, block_count_index, profile_index, observation_family_index]). Corrected/misspecified detection share family index 3 for paired identical latent resources/inclusion draws, while all outer datasets within a scenario are independent. Stage indices: development 0, evaluation 1.
config.interpretation: Calibrates statistical operating characteristics for declared complete-profile targets and observation processes. Generating profiles and resource allocation are imposed; this is method validation, not evidence for autonomous allocation or a novel natural law.

benchmark_gate.monte_carlo_intervals: Wilson binomial intervals over independent outer datasets within each scenario; bootstrap draws are internal, not independent validation trials. Detection-corrected/misspecified scenarios share paired latent inputs.
benchmark_gate.retention: All outer means, profile bounds, decisions, bootstrap radii and zero flags; first eight full block-vector inputs per scenario. Remaining generated inputs reconstruct exactly from frozen source, NumPy version and recorded SeedSequence recipes. Inner bootstrap indices are regenerated, not retained.
benchmark_gate.inference: Simultaneous centered-vector bootstrap is approximate. Known-bound ratio reference is distribution-free only under true independent bounded blocks and correct observation weights. Percentile Delta lower extension is not the historical method.
benchmark_gate.solar_preread_gate: Independent exchangeable calendar months, adequate tail regularity and physical block-fluence bounds are not established. Solar robust primary verdict remains unresolved; approximate bootstrap classification is conditional exploratory.
benchmark_gate.interpretation: Calibrates statistical operating characteristics for declared complete-profile targets and observation processes. Generating profiles and resource allocation are imposed; this is method validation, not evidence for autonomous allocation or a novel natural law.

integrated_irrad_peak.interpretation: Diagnostics of observed development support and temporal variability; no inferred physical upper bound or proof of independent exchangeable months.

integrated_irrad_end.interpretation: Diagnostics of observed development support and temporal variability; no inferred physical upper bound or proof of independent exchangeable months.

application_gate.formal_profile_ineligibility_reason: This observational solar design does not independently establish the IID/exchangeable-month assumptions of bootstrap bands; no independently defensible physical per-block fluence bound is available. Benchmark success alone cannot establish solar sampling assumptions.
application_gate.allowed_use: Frozen forecasts, measured full profiles, cost-transfer diagnostics and explicitly conditional candidate bands; formal neutrality verdict remains unresolved.

paired_count_log_score.interpretation: Positive favors historical counts. Sum of event-category log forecasts conditional on observed complete-case N; the common multinomial combinatorial term is omitted. Month-bootstrap comparison is a conditional nominal score summary, not an independent-event likelihood-ratio test.

centered_bootstrap.assumptions: Approximate IID whole-block bootstrap; positive population bin means and sufficient moments/regularity for joint mean-vector approximation. Verify sampling design and calibrated regimes separately.

percentile_max.interpretation: Historical whole-profile percentile-maximum upper component only; lower percentile and three-way extension are evaluated separately in the benchmark.

bounded_reference.reason: No independently established almost-sure block-resource bounds supplied

integrated_irrad_peak.interval_endpoint_policy: None in a log lower endpoint means minus infinity; in a log upper or departure upper endpoint it means plus infinity; explicit unbounded/zero flags are retained.
integrated_irrad_peak.target: Normalized mean block-resource totals per fixed logarithmic bin width, pooled before normalization; population total resource assumed positive.
